scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays product name, tagline, description, and call-to-action buttons prominently

steps.description: Navigate to the MirDB homepage in a web browser
steps.context: Homepage must be accessible via HTTP/HTTPS

steps.description: Check that hero section is immediately visible without scrolling
steps.context: Hero section should be above the fold on standard viewport

steps.description: Confirm presence of product name 'MirDB', tagline, and brief description
steps.context: Content must accurately represent MirDB capabilities

steps.description: Check for 'Get Started' or 'View on GitHub' primary CTA and 'Documentation' secondary CTA
steps.context: CTAs should be clearly visible and actionable

test_cases.input: Load homepage and inspect hero section HTML
test_cases.expected: Hero section contains h1 with 'MirDB', tagline text mentioning 'Persistent Key-Value Store' and 'Memcached Protocol'

test_cases.input: Check hero section for description paragraph
test_cases.expected: Description paragraph exists with 2-3 sentences explaining MirDB
Primary CTA button exists with text 'Get Started' or 'View on GitHub' and links to appropriate destination
Secondary CTA button exists with text 'Documentation'

scenarios.name: Key Features Section
scenarios.description: Verify the features section showcases MirDB's key capabilities: Memcached protocol support, persistence, and LSM tree architecture

steps.description: Scroll to or locate the features section on the homepage
steps.context: Features section should be easily accessible

steps.description: Check for at least 3 feature cards or blocks
steps.context: Each feature should be visually distinct

steps.description: Confirm presence of Memcached protocol compatibility feature with description
steps.context: Should explain seamless use with existing memcached clients

steps.description: Confirm presence of persistent storage feature with SSTable mention
Confirm presence of LSM tree architecture feature with Tokio async I/O

test_cases.input: Inspect features section HTML for feature count
test_cases.expected: Features section contains at least 3 distinct feature elements
Feature text includes 'Memcached' and mentions client compatibility
Feature text includes 'Persistent' or 'Persistence' and mentions 'SSTable' or 'storage'

test_cases.input: Search for LSM tree feature content
test_cases.expected: Feature text includes 'LSM' and mentions performance or 'Tokio'

scenarios.name: Quick Start Code Examples
scenarios.description: Verify the quick start section provides clear installation and usage code examples with syntax highlighting

steps.description: Scroll to or locate the quick start section on the homepage
Check for installation or startup command example
steps.context: Should show how to start MirDB server

steps.description: Check for GET and SET operation examples
steps.context: Should demonstrate basic memcached protocol usage

steps.description: Confirm code blocks have syntax highlighting applied
steps.context: Code should be readable with proper color coding

test_cases.input: Locate quick start section and inspect for code blocks
test_cases.expected: Quick start section exists with at least 2 code example blocks
Code block contains 'mirdb' command or equivalent startup instruction
Code block demonstrates SET command usage with expected 'STORED' response
Code block demonstrates GET command usage with VALUE response

test_cases.input: Inspect code blocks for syntax highlighting classes or styles
test_cases.expected: Code blocks have syntax highlighting applied via CSS classes or inline styles

scenarios.name: Mobile Responsive Design
scenarios.description: Verify the homepage displays correctly on mobile devices with proper formatting

steps.description: Configure browser viewport to 320px width (minimum mobile)
Check that all content fits within viewport without horizontal overflow
steps.context: Content should reflow for narrow screens

steps.description: Check that all text is readable without zooming
steps.context: Font sizes should be appropriate for mobile

steps.description: Check that navigation is usable on mobile
steps.context: May use hamburger menu or simplified navigation

steps.description: Configure viewport to 768px width and verify layout

test_cases.expected: Page renders without horizontal scroll bar, all content visible
Hero section content is fully visible and readable
Code blocks are scrollable horizontally within their container or wrap appropriately
Navigation is accessible via mobile-friendly controls (hamburger menu or visible links)
Page displays appropriate tablet layout with proper spacing
Buttons and links have adequate touch target size (minimum 44x44px)

test_cases.expected: No critical accessibility violations reported
All text meets WCAG AA contrast requirements (4.5:1 normal, 3:1 large)
All interactive elements (links, buttons) are reachable via Tab key

test_cases.input: Check all images for alt attributes
test_cases.expected: All img elements have descriptive alt text or empty alt for decorative images
Page has logical heading structure (h1, h2, h3) without skipped levels
Focused elements have visible focus indicators
